intent: Extend the existing R/J/O request/projection preflight to the current-main issue execution entry so both new and long-lived worker branches reject the same guaranteed-invalid dimensions_complete=false composition before database execution, and teach disposable agents the distinction without changing epistemic semantics.
rationale_summary: No capability is missing. PR #191 already added the same-ref worker-fast preflight under CAP-0003/CAP-0007/CAP-0009/CAP-0010, but active industry branches created before that merge do not inherit its workflow step. The default-branch issue workflow is the existing central execution choke point, so reusing it closes the rollout gap without a new capability, worker-cursor cross-write, or semantic change.
